company and stealing the answers.

Face's production database, and pulled
the answer key. 17,000 automated actions
without any human in the loop. The
headline said, "An AI went rogue."
Nothing malfunctioned because every step
of that heist was the model doing
exactly what it was trained to do. This
is reward hacking. And by the end of
this video, you'll see it everywhere,
including your own code base.
